schema.text: What gets in your way on your usual bike route?

options.text: Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane
People on foot or e-scooters in the cycle lane
Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path
A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly
No crossings or traffic lights for bikes
Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot leave the vehicle where I arrive
Stairs or steps on the route with no ramp or wheel channel

it.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Cosa ti ostacola sul tuo percorso abituale in bici?
it.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Auto o furgoni parcheggiati sulla corsia ciclabile
it.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Pedoni o monopattini elettrici sulla corsia ciclabile
it.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Bidoni, cartelli o pannelli sulla pista ciclabile
it.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Nessun attraversamento o semaforo per le bici
it.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Limiti dell'area del servizio in condivisione: non posso lasciare il mezzo dove arrivo
it.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Scale o gradini lungo il percorso senza rampa o canalina per le ruote
it.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: Pista o corsia ciclabile che si interrompe

fr.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Qu'est-ce qui vous gêne sur votre trajet habituel à vélo ?
fr.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Voitures ou camionnettes garées sur la piste cyclable
fr.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Piétons ou trottinettes électriques sur la piste cyclable
fr.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Poubelles, panneaux ou affiches sur la piste cyclable
fr.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Pas de passages ni de feux pour les vélos
fr.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Les limites de la zone de libre-service : je ne peux pas laisser le véhicule là où j'arrive
fr.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Des escaliers ou des marches sur le trajet sans rampe ni goulotte pour les roues
fr.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: Une piste ou bande cyclable qui s’interrompt

de.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Was behindert Sie auf Ihrer üblichen Radstrecke?
de.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Auf dem Radweg geparkte Autos oder Transporter
de.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Fußgänger oder E-Scooter auf dem Radweg
de.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Mülltonnen, Schilder oder Tafeln auf dem Radweg
de.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Keine Übergänge oder Ampeln für Fahrräder
de.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Grenzen des Sharing-Gebiets: Ich kann das Fahrzeug nicht dort abstellen, wo ich ankomme
de.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Treppen oder Stufen auf der Strecke ohne Rampe oder Schieberinne
de.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: Ein Radweg oder Radfahrstreifen, der plötzlich endet

tr.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Her zamanki bisiklet güzergâhınızda sizi ne engelliyor?
tr.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Bisiklet şeridine park edilmiş otomobiller veya minibüsler
tr.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Bisiklet şeridinde yayalar veya elektrikli scooter'lar
tr.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Bisiklet yolunda çöp kutuları, tabelalar veya panolar
tr.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Bisikletler için geçit veya trafik ışığı yok
tr.#Badly designed junctions or roundabouts: Kötü tasarlanmış kavşaklar veya dönel kavşaklar
tr.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Paylaşım bölgesinin sınırları: aracı vardığım yerde bırakamıyorum
tr.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Güzergâhta rampası veya tekerlek kanalı olmayan merdiven ya da basamaklar
tr.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: Aniden sona eren bisiklet yolu veya şeridi

fa.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: در مسیر معمول دوچرخه‌سواری شما چه چیزی مانع می‌شود؟
fa.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: خودرو یا ون پارک‌شده در مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: عابران پیاده یا اسکوتر برقی در مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: سطل زباله، علامت یا تابلو در مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: گذرگاه یا چراغ راهنمایی برای دوچرخه وجود ندارد
fa.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: محدودهٔ منطقهٔ اشتراکی: نمی‌توانم وسیله را در جایی که می‌رسم رها کنم
fa.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: پله یا پلکان در مسیر بدون رمپ یا ریل مخصوص چرخ
fa.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: مسیر یا خط دوچرخه که ناگهان قطع می‌شود

hu.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: Mi akadályozza a szokásos kerékpáros útvonalán?
hu.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: Autók vagy kisteherautók parkolnak a kerékpársávban
hu.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: Gyalogosok vagy elektromos rollerek a kerékpársávban
hu.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: Kukák, táblák vagy hirdetőtáblák a kerékpárúton
hu.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: Nincs átkelő vagy lámpa a kerékpárosoknak
hu.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: A megosztási zóna határai: nem hagyhatom ott a járművet, ahová megérkezem
hu.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Lépcsők vagy lépcsőfokok az útvonalon rámpa vagy tolósín nélkül

ar.#What gets in your way on your usual bik: ما الذي يعترض طريقك في مسارك المعتاد بالدراجة؟
ar.#Potholes, bumps or cobblestones: حُفر أو مطبّات أو حجارة الرصف
ar.#Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane: سيارات أو شاحنات صغيرة متوقفة في مسار الدراجات
ar.#People on foot or e-scooters in the cyc: أشخاص يمشون أو سكوترات كهربائية في مسار الدراجات
ar.#Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path: حاويات قمامة أو لافتات أو لوحات في مسار الدراجات
ar.#No crossings or traffic lights for bike: لا توجد معابر أو إشارات مرور للدراجات
ar.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: حدود منطقة خدمة المشاركة: لا أستطيع ترك المركبة حيث أصل
ar.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: سلالم أو درجات على الطريق دون منحدر أو مجرى للعجلات
ar.#A cycle path or lane that ends abruptly: مسار أو حارة للدراجات تنتهي فجأة
